rv.q: That this play is based on the afore-mentioned weekend Wilkinson spent in Paris may be intriguing to ponder, but unfortunately, its murkiness mars it.
This superbly acted psychological/supernatural thriller is vintage Wilkinson.
M is a work in progress; the acting is top-notch.

cn.t: Critics are divided on this atmospheric thriller, with praise for top-notch acting but concerns the script remains a work in progress, though some find it delivers genuine chills.
